## Computing Summary Statistics

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

data <- read.csv("The_Significant_Five_dataset.csv")
```

### Quantitative Variables

```{r quantitative-summary, echo=FALSE}
quan_vars <- c(
  "budget_cad",
  "judgment_worry",
  "general_embarrassment",
  "communication_discomfort",
  "max_wtp_cad"
)

summary_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = quan_vars,
  Median = sapply(data[quan_vars], median),
  Mean = sapply(data[quan_vars], mean),
  SD = sapply(data[quan_vars], sd),
  IQR = sapply(data[quan_vars], IQR),
  Range = sapply(data[quan_vars], function(x) {
    sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f)", min(x), max(x))
  }),
  n = sapply(data[quan_vars], length)
)
summary_table[, 2:5] <- round(summary_table[, 2:5], 2)
rownames(summary_table) <- NULL
kable(
  summary_table,
  caption = "Summary Statistics",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = "lrrrrrr"
)
```

### Brief Interpretation

Of the 92 respondents, 58 (63.04%) were domestic students and 34 (36.96%) were international students. Most respondents reported that they embarrassed easily (66.30%) and were self-conscious (77.17%). For the willingness-to-pay scenarios, 22.83% reported willingness to pay CAD 5 to avoid lateness, while 61.96% indicated willingness to buy the CAD 20 shirt in the specified scenario.

## Frequency Tables


```{r qualitative-summary, echo=FALSE}
qual_vars <- c(
  "student_status",
  "embarrassed_easily",
  "self_conscious",
  "pay5_lateness",
  "buy20_shirt"
)

freq_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(qual_vars, function(v) {
  counts <- table(data[[v]])
  percentages <- prop.table(counts) * 100

  data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    Value = names(counts),
    N = as.vector(counts),
    `Raw %` = round(as.vector(percentages), 2),
    `Valid %` = round(as.vector(percentages), 2),
    `Cumulative %` = round(cumsum(as.vector(percentages)), 2),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))

rownames(freq_table) <- NULL

kable(
  freq_table,
  caption = "Frequency Table",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = "lrrrrr"
)
```

## Brief Interpretation

Of the 92 respondents, 58 (63.04%) were domestic students and 34 (36.96%) were international students. The frequency tables also summarize responses to the embarrassment-related questions and the two willingness-to-pay scenarios.
